UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

Flag

Public wasm surface — one flag canvas per instance.

frame

frame — one animation tick: pack, write, draw. Skips silently until textures land (no bind group yet — an unbound draw would be a validation error).

  • @param dt Seconds since the previous call.
  • @param {number} dt

init

init — device + pipeline + sampler; the bind group builds once textures land (upload_textures → rebind).

  • @param canvas The widget's dedicated canvas.
  • @param device The shared GPUDevice (one per page, from the JS bridge).
  • @returns Ok on a live surface, Err(JsValue) on failure.
  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
  • @param {GPUDevice} device

constructor

Flag::new — un-initialized widget; init must follow.

resize

resize — canvas-bitmap change → surface re-configure.

  • @param _w Device-pixel width (element-side).
  • @param _h Device-pixel height.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_size

set_size — the canvas's CSS-pixel size (res + rect).

  • @param w Canvas width in CSS pixels.
  • @param h Canvas height in CSS pixels.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_state

set_state — bundled scalar update: hover amount, the locale personality, and the split-flag geometry.

  • @param hover 0..1 hover amount.
  • @param anim Locale personality 0..11 (GPU_FLAG_ANIMS).
  • @param is_split 0 single / 1 split flag.
  • @param split_x Seam position 0..1.
  • @param {number} hover
  • @param {number} anim
  • @param {number} is_split
  • @param {number} split_x

upload_textures

upload_textures — stage one or two RGBA8 flag images. Single- flag widgets pass rgba_b identical to rgba_a (the shader reads tex2 only when is_split=1 — a duplicate binding is the cheapest no-op). Rebuilds the bind group so the new textures go live next frame.

ImageBitmap inputs — the browser decodes the SVG off-main- thread and copyExternalImageToTexture moves pixels GPU→GPU, so no CPU pixel round-trip ever touches the flag path.

  • @param a The primary flag's decoded bitmap.
  • @param b The secondary flag's decoded bitmap (same as a for
  • @param {ImageBitmap} a
  • @param {ImageBitmap} b
